name: Crasus Chemical Inc.
summary: Crasus Chemical Inc. manufactures petrochemical products in Japan. The company produces basic petrochemicals, organic chemicals, synthetic resins, and other derivatives at the Oita Petrochemical Complex. It manufactures olefins, including ethylene and propylene, through naphtha cracker furnaces that process naphtha, liquefied petroleum gas, condensate, and kerosene/diesel as feedstocks. The company also manufactures organic chemicals using acetic acid as the principal raw material, including ethyl acetate, vinyl acetate, and allyl alcohol.
